cases.name: a message that carries an event is valid
cases.why: The hub sets `room`, `seq`, `event_id`, and `ts` on a message that carries an event.

cases.name: a message about the connection is valid without room, seq, event_id, and ts
cases.why: Only `v`, `type`, `sender`, and `payload` are required.

cases.name: a null payload is valid
cases.why: `payload` must be present, and any JSON value is accepted.

informational.reason: payload: Invalid input: expected nonoptional, received undefined

cases.name: a missing payload is invalid
cases.why: `payload` is required.

informational.reason: v: Invalid input: expected number, received undefined

cases.name: a missing v is invalid
cases.why: `v` is required.

informational.reason: v: Too small: expected number to be >0

cases.name: a v of zero is invalid
cases.why: `v` is greater than zero.

cases.name: a v of 2 is valid
cases.why: The envelope schema does not fix `v` to one version. Version negotiation happens in the `hello` message.

informational.reason: type: Too small: expected string to have >=1 characters

cases.name: an empty type is invalid
cases.why: `type` is not empty.

cases.name: a type that no message defines is valid
cases.why: The envelope schema accepts any `type` that is not empty, because version 1 defines the payload of `event` only. The hub and the daemon of the reference parse with a message schema that rejects a type that it has no payload for.

informational.reason: payload.id: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined; payload.seq: Invalid input: expected number, received undefined; payload.mission: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined; payload.type: Invalid option: expected one of "status"|"claim"|"release"|"decision"|"question"|"answer"|"blocked"|"request"|"policy.denied"|"policy.override"|"policy.override.revoked"|"ledger.adopted"|"decision.confirm"|"artifact"|"human"|"check.timeout-pass"|"handoff.offered"|"handoff.accepted"|"handoff.declined"|"handoff.completed"|"handoff.cancelled"; payload.agent: Invalid input: expected object, received undefined; payload.on_behalf_of: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined; payload.at: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined; payload.body: Invalid input: expected nonoptional, received undefined

cases.name: an event message with an empty payload is invalid
cases.why: The payload of a message with the type `event` is a stored Room event.

informational.reason: payload: Invalid input: expected object, received null

cases.name: an event message with a null payload is invalid
cases.why: The payload of a message with the type `event` is a stored Room event.

informational.reason: payload.type: Invalid option: expected one of "status"|"claim"|"release"|"decision"|"question"|"answer"|"blocked"|"request"|"policy.denied"|"policy.override"|"policy.override.revoked"|"ledger.adopted"|"decision.confirm"|"artifact"|"human"|"check.timeout-pass"|"handoff.offered"|"handoff.accepted"|"handoff.declined"|"handoff.completed"|"handoff.cancelled"

cases.name: an event message whose event has an unknown type is invalid
cases.why: The payload is validated as a stored Room event, so its `type` must be in the list.

informational.reason: payload.body: item: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined; paths: Invalid input: expected array, received undefined; intent: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined; ttl_seconds: Invalid input: expected number, received undefined

cases.name: an event message whose body does not match the event type is invalid
cases.why: The payload is validated as a stored Room event, body included.

cases.name: an event message without room, seq, event_id, and ts is valid
cases.why: The schema does not require the fields that the hub sets on an event message.

informational.reason: sender.kind: Invalid option: expected one of "daemon"|"dashboard"|"server"

cases.name: a sender kind outside the list is invalid
cases.why: `sender.kind` is `daemon`, `dashboard`, or `server`.

informational.reason: sender.id: Too small: expected string to have >=1 characters

cases.name: a sender with an empty id is invalid
cases.why: `sender.id` is not empty.

informational.reason: sender: Invalid input: expected object, received undefined

cases.name: a missing sender is invalid
cases.why: `sender` is required.

informational.reason: seq: Too small: expected number to be >=0

cases.name: a negative seq is invalid
cases.why: `seq`, when present, is not negative.

informational.reason: room: Too small: expected string to have >=1 characters

cases.name: an empty room is invalid
cases.why: `room`, when present, is not empty.

cases.name: an unknown top-level field is valid
cases.why: The envelope keeps fields that the schema does not name.

description: Valid and invalid transport envelopes. The verdict of a message with the type `event` comes from the message schema that the hub and the daemon of the reference parse with. The verdict of every other message comes from the envelope schema of the reference, because version 1 defines no other payload.
